72249-through-time-and-space-with-benedi.title: Through Time And Space With Benedict Breadfruit
72249-through-time-and-space-with-benedi.creator: Unknown
72249-through-time-and-space-with-benedi.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. On the planet Tenta I, plants of the melon and related families were so rare that the king himself had issued a royal fiat to protect them. Not knowing this, Benedict Breadfruit's young son started to pick a pumpkin. Fortunately, his father stopped him in time.

arxiv-1809-02428.title: Multitask and Multilingual Modelling for Lexical Analysis Journal: Künstliche Intelligenz
arxiv-1809-02428.creator: Johannes Bjerva
arxiv-1809-02428.description: Abstract In Natural Language Processing (NLP), one traditionally considers a single task (e.g. part-of-speech tagging) for a single language (e.g. English) at a time. However, recent work has shown that it can be beneficial to take advantage of relatedness between tasks, as well as between languages.

arxiv-1907-08542.title: Numerical Methods for Simulating Star Formation
arxiv-1907-08542.creator: Romain Teyssier 1,∗ and Benoît Commerçon 2
arxiv-1907-08542.description: Abstract We review the numerical techniques for ideal and non-ideal magneto-hydrodynamics (MHD) used in the context of star formation simulations. We outline the specific challenges offered by modeling star forming environments, which are dominated by supersonic and super-Alfvénic turbulence in a radiative, self-gravitating fluid.

arxiv-2002-00550.title: A two-sided Faulhaber-like formula involving Bernoulli polynomials
arxiv-2002-00550.creator: J. Fernando Barbero G, Juan Margalef-Bentabol, Eduardo J.S. Villaseñor
arxiv-2002-00550.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by J. Fernando Barbero G, Juan Margalef-Bentabol, Eduardo J.S. Villaseñor. We give a new identity involving Bernoulli polynomials and combinatorial numbers. This provides, in particular, a Faulhaber-like formula for sums of the form 1 m ​ ( n − 1 ) m + 2 m ​ ( n − 2 ) m + ⋯ + ( n − 1 ) m ​ 1 m \displaystyle 1^{m}(n-1)^{m}+2^{m}(n-2)^{m}+\cdots+(n-1)^{m}1^{m} for positive integers m m and n n .

arxiv-2010-13649.title: Using neural networks to accelerate the solution of the Boltzmann equation
arxiv-2010-13649.creator: Tianbai Xiao, Martin Frank
arxiv-2010-13649.description: Abstract One of the biggest challenges for simulating the Boltzmann equation is the evaluation of fivefold collision integral. Given the recent successes of deep learning and the availability of efficient tools, it is an obvious idea to try to substitute the evaluation of the collision operator by the evaluation of a neural network.

arxiv-2203-14974.title: On the Sound Speed in Neutron Stars
arxiv-2203-14974.creator: Sinan Altiparmak, Christian Ecker, Luciano Rezzolla
arxiv-2203-14974.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sinan Altiparmak, Christian Ecker, Luciano Rezzolla. Determining the sound speed c s c_{s} in compact stars is an important open question with numerous implications on the behaviour of matter at large densities and hence on gravitational-wave emission from neutron stars. To this scope, we construct more than 10 7 10^{7} equations of state (EOSs) with continuous sound speed and build more than 10 8 10^{8} nonrotating stellar models consistent not only with nuclear theory and perturbative QCD, but also with astronomical observations.

arxiv-2310-17039.title: The limiting distribution of a random variable transformed by Chebyshev Polynomials
arxiv-2310-17039.creator: Javier Chico Vázquez, Andrew J. Horning
arxiv-2310-17039.description: Abstract In this paper we present the result of successively applying a Chebyshev polynomial to a continuous random variable. In particular we show that under mild assumptions the limiting distribution will be the same as the weight with respect to which Chebyshev polynomials are orthogonal, namely ∼ ( 1 − t 2 ) − 1 2 \sim(1-t^{2})^{-\frac{1}{2}} .

arxiv-2405-01675.title: Clones, closed categories, and combinatory logic (longer version) Thanks: Supported by the Air Force Office of Scientific Research under award number FA9550-21-1-0038.
arxiv-2405-01675.creator: Philip Saville
arxiv-2405-01675.description: Abstract We give an exposition of the semantics of the simply-typed λ \uplambda -calculus, and its linear and ordered variants, using multi-ary structures. We define universal properties for multicategories, and use these to derive familiar rules for products, tensors, and exponentials. Finally we explain how to recover both the category-theoretic syntactic model and its semantic interpretation from the multi-ary framework.

arxiv-2406-03836.title: Proactive Detection of Physical Inter-rule Vulnerabilities in IoT Services Using a Deep Learning Approach
arxiv-2406-03836.creator: Bing Huang 1 , Chen Chen 1 🖂, Kwok-Yan Lam 1 , Fuqun Huang 2
arxiv-2406-03836.description: Abstract Emerging Internet of Things (IoT) platforms provide sophisticated capabilities to automate IoT services by enabling occupants to create trigger-action rules. Multiple trigger-action rules can physically interact with each other via shared environment channels, such as temperature, humidity, and illumination. We refer to inter-rule interactions via shared environment channels as a physical inter-rule vulnerability .

arxiv-2408-00260.title: MHD lensing in inhomogeneous ISM for qualitative understanding of the morphology of supernova remnants
arxiv-2408-00260.creator: Yoshiaki Sofue Institute of Astronomy, The University of Tokyo, Mitaka, Tokyo 186-0015, Japan
arxiv-2408-00260.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yoshiaki Sofue Institute of Astronomy, The University of Tokyo, Mitaka, Tokyo 186-0015, Japan. Morphological evolution of expanding shells of fast-mode magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) waves through an inhomogeneous ISM is investigated in order to qualitatively understand the complicated morphology of shell-type supernova remnants (SNR). Interstellar clouds with high Alfvén velocity act as concave lenses to diverge the MHD waves, while those with slow Alfvén velocity act as convex lenses to converge the waves to the focal points.

arxiv-2409-06740.title: Data-efficient and interpretable inverse materials design using a disentangled variational autoencoder
arxiv-2409-06740.creator: Cheng Zeng, Zulqarnain Khan, Nathan L. Post
arxiv-2409-06740.description: Abstract Inverse materials design has proven successful in accelerating novel material discovery. Many inverse materials design methods use unsupervised learning where a latent space is learned to offer a compact description of materials representations. A latent space learned this way is likely to be entangled, in terms of the target property and other properties of the materials.

arxiv-2411-01834.title: Align-SLM : Textless Spoken Language Models with Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback
arxiv-2411-01834.creator: Guan-Ting Lin, Prashanth Gurunath Shivakumar, Aditya Gourav, Yile Gu Ankur Gandhe Hung-yi Lee Ivan Bulyko
arxiv-2411-01834.description: Abstract While textless Spoken Language Models (SLMs) have shown potential in end-to-end speech-to-speech modeling, they still lag behind text-based Large Language Models (LLMs) in terms of semantic coherence and relevance. This work introduces the Align-SLM framework, which leverages preference optimization inspired by Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback (RLAIF) to enhance the semantic understanding of SLMs.

arxiv-2411-03762.title: Deterministic two-photon C-Z gate with the two-photon quantum Rabi model
arxiv-2411-03762.creator: Jia-Cheng Tang, Jin Zhao, Haitao Yang, Junlong Tian, Pinghua Tang, Shuai-Peng Wang, Lucas Lamata, Jie Peng
arxiv-2411-03762.description: Abstract We propose a scheme for realizing a deterministic two-photon C-Z gate based on variants of the two-photon quantum Rabi model (QRM), which is feasible within the framework of circuit QED. We begin by utilizing the two-photon interaction to implement the nonlinear sign (NS) gate, and subsequently, we construct the C-Z gate following the KLM scheme.

arxiv-2501-02420.title: Accurate calculation of bubble and droplet properties in diffuse-interface two-phase simulations
arxiv-2501-02420.creator: Pranav J. Nathan, Suhas S. Jain
arxiv-2501-02420.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the challenge of accurately calculating droplet/bubble properties (e.g., volume, number) in diffuse-interface two-phase flow simulations. Currently, flood-fill algorithms can truncate a significant portion of the volume of droplets/bubbles contained within the diffuse interface region or artificially merge multiple droplets/bubbles.

arxiv-2507-17370.title: Clustering, order conditions, and languages of interval exchanges
arxiv-2507-17370.creator: Sébastien Ferenczi, Luca Q. Zamboni
arxiv-2507-17370.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sébastien Ferenczi, Luca Q. Zamboni. For any interval exchange transformation T T (standard or generalized), if we define a morphism ϕ \phi from the set of letters to the set of the return words of a word in the natural coding, respecting the lexicographical order, the word ϕ ​ v \phi v clusters (for the Burrows-Wheeler transform) for the permutation of T T if and only if the word v v clusters for the permutation of the induced map of T T on the

arxiv-2508-11159.title: Mitigating Modality Quantity and Quality Imbalance in Multimodal Online Federated Learning
arxiv-2508-11159.creator: Heqiang Wang, Weihong Yang, Xiaoxiong Zhong, Jia Zhou, Fangming Liu, Weizhe Zhang
arxiv-2508-11159.description: Abstract The Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem produces massive volumes of multimodal data from diverse sources, including sensors, cameras, and microphones. With advances in edge intelligence, IoT devices have evolved from simple data acquisition units into computationally capable nodes, enabling localized processing of heterogeneous multimodal data. This evolution necessitates distributed learning paradigms that can efficiently handle such data.

arxiv-2510-23485.title: Tighter CMI-Based Generalization Bounds via Stochastic Projection and Quantization
arxiv-2510-23485.creator: Milad Sefidgaran, Kimia Nadjahi, Abdellatif Zaidi
arxiv-2510-23485.description: Abstract In this paper, we leverage stochastic projection and lossy compression to establish new conditional mutual information (CMI) bounds on the generalization error of statistical learning algorithms. It is shown that these bounds are generally tighter than the existing ones.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-raphael-badiu.title: Raphael Badius (Catholic Encyclopedia article)
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-raphael-badiu.creator: John Volz
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-raphael-badiu.description: Article 'Raphael Badius' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10686769.title: Visualization of parasite dynamics in the host tissues: application of tissue transparency technology to parasite research
pmc-10686769.creator: Yasuhiro TAKASHIMA
pmc-10686769.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Many parasite species migrate to another site of infection after entering the host body. Such parasite dynamics are closely related to pathogenicity, but it is not easy to observe such parasite behavior deep within the organs. In recent years, technology that can make organs transparent has been developed that enables us to observe deep within organs ex vivo while maintaining their three-dimensional structure.

pmc-11377510.title: New and Emerging Drug and Gene Therapies for Friedreich Ataxia
pmc-11377510.creator: Varlli Scott, Martin B Delatycki, Geneieve Tai, Louise A Corben
pmc-11377510.description: The life shortening nature of Friedreich Ataxia (FRDA) demands the search for therapies that can delay, stop or reverse its relentless trajectory. This review provides a contemporary position of drug and gene therapies for FRDA currently in phase 1 clinical trials and beyond.

pmc-11402065.title: In Humans, Insulo-striate Structural Connectivity is Largely Biased Toward Either Striosome-like or Matrix-like Striatal Compartments
pmc-11402065.creator: Adrian T Funk, Asim AO Hassan, Jeff L Waugh
pmc-11402065.description: The insula is an integral component of sensory, motor, limbic, and executive functions, and insular dysfunction is associated with numerous human neuropsychiatric disorders. Insular efferents project widely, but insulo-striate projections are especially numerous. The targets of these insulo-striate projections are organized into tissue compartments, the striosome and matrix.

pmc-11422489.title: 3D printed teeth with adhesive bridge preparation guide
pmc-11422489.creator: Michael del Hougne, Greta Behr, Marc Schmitter, Christian Höhne
pmc-11422489.description: In this study a 3D printed tooth with adhesive bridge preparation guide was designed and tested for feasibility and evaluated by students. The tooth, printed by a stereolithographic printer, consisted of two differently colored layers with an integrated adhesive bridge preparation. This showed the extent and thickness of the preparation.

pmc-12812988.title: How does a simulated high-intensity functional training competition influence on stress, recovery and muscle power?
pmc-12812988.creator: Paulo Vitor de Souza Barboza, Stephany Fernandes da Rocha Rodrigues, Rodolfo André Dellagrana, Alberto Kruschewsky, Déborah de Araújo Farias, Mateus Rossato
pmc-12812988.description: High-intensity functional training (HIFT) has increased the number of practitioners who find in the modality a way to improve their health levels. HIFT sessions are called “Workout of the day” (WODs), and in addition to training sessions, some practitioners choose to participate in competitions (HIFT_C). Competitions are held on consecutive days and can raise stress levels and affect recovery.

pmc-13031955.title: Identification of an age-related monocyte-derived macrophages characteristic genes-based signature for high-grade diffuse glioma
pmc-13031955.creator: Wenjuan Chen, Yuanyuan Xie, Huifang Pan, Xuewen Li, Tianyu Qin, Boxin Zhang, Shuanghui Guo, Zhanxiang Wang, Hongda Li, Fanghui Lu, Shaoxuan Chen
pmc-13031955.description: Monocyte-derived macrophages (MDMs) have been associated with increased infiltration proportion and shorter overall survival (OS) in diffuse gliomas (DGs), particularly contributing to poor prognosis in elderly patients. However, the criteria for predicting the suitability and efficacy of MDM-targeted therapy in cancer treatment remain unclear.

pmc-13052127.title: Evaluation of the Hyoid Bone Position Based on the Hyoid Triangle in Patients With Different Skeletal Patterns: A Lateral Cephalometry Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13052127.creator: Maryam Karandish, Mahvash Hasani, Sahar Dialameh
pmc-13052127.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and AimsWe aimed to compare the hyoid bone triangle among individuals with Class I, II, and III skeletal patterns, considering different facial growth patterns.MethodsA total of 296 patients were included in the study. Skeletal patterns were classified using the A Point‐Nasion‐B Point (ANB) angle and Wit's appraisal, while the Bjork angle and Jarabak index were employed to categorize facial growth patterns (vertical, horizontal, and normal).

pmc-13348547.title: Knowledge, attitude, and practices on gestational weight gain among pregnant women, partners, female household members, and healthcare providers: a mixed-method study in Tanzania
pmc-13348547.creator: Emmy Metta, Alfa Muhihi, Mohamed Bakari, Andrea B Pembe, Dongqing Wang
pmc-13348547.description: BackgroundGestational weight gain (GWG) is a significant indicator of the mother’s health and the quality of life of her growing fetus. However, little is documented on knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding GWG management in low— and middle-income countries, particularly in Tanzania.

pmc-13533208.title: From pustule to flap: necrotizing fasciitis of the breast in type 1 diabetes—a case report
pmc-13533208.creator: Emre Tunç, Ökkeş Çimen
pmc-13533208.description: Necrotizing soft tissue infections of the breast are exceptionally rare surgical emergencies with high mortality, and monomicrobial Escherichia coli (Type 3) necrotizing fasciitis is an uncommon, highly virulent form. We report a 23-year-old woman with insulin-treated Type 1 diabetes mellitus as her only comorbidity who developed extensive breast necrosis from a small pustule and presented with sepsis.

pmc-13568532.title: Bioplating demonstrates increasing micromovement during cyclic loading after anterior closed wedge high tibial osteotomy despite no significant difference in failure load compared to angle‐stable plate fixation
pmc-13568532.creator: Andrzej Jasina, Pia Metje, Jan‐Oliver Sass, Jessica Hembus, Sjard Simons, Sina Gräber, Kira Liebau, Rainer Bader, Philipp Schuster, Maeruan Kebbach, Parisa Pourostad, Christoph Lutter, Felix Ferner
pmc-13568532.description: PurposeTo biomechanically compare fixation stability after anterior closed wedge high tibial osteotomy (ACW‐HTO) for posterior tibial slope (PTS) correction using trans‐tuberosity “bioplating” and infra‐tuberosity angle‐stable plate fixation.MethodsIn this cadaveric biomechanical study, fresh‐frozen human knee specimens were allocated in a paired donor‐matched manner to the two intervention groups.

pmc-13613711.title: Adaptation of a clinical practice guideline for home care nursing in heart failure patients: a multi-method study
pmc-13613711.creator: Leila Hashemlu, Roghayeh Esmaeili, Fatemeh Bahramnezhad, Camelia Rohani
pmc-13613711.description: BackgroundThe demand for home healthcare services for chronic conditions has increased due to the transition of care from hospitals to the home. This study aimed to adapt a Clinical Practice Guideline (CPG) for home-based nursing care of adult patients with heart failure in the healthcare system of Iran.
